lines: I had crossed the mountain and was frantically hurrying down the path towards Gosha.
My arm holding Saya on my back was getting numb. Lifting my tired legs, I simply kept moving forward, one step after the other.
(A little further... just a little further. Once I make it into Gosha...)
When I looked up, I could see the sky above the mountains beginning to turn white. It was almost dawn.
Then a figure emerged against the light.
I had been counting on you, but you disappointed me.
However, standing there was one of my pursuersーthe Masked Madam herself. It couldn't get more dire than this.
Counting on me...? You still didn't seem to trust me though.
Having Akitsu and Asuka watch over us, and even hiring mercenaries. You've been thorough.
You don't have a chance. Hand over that girl.
I've never been one to give up.
As soon as I spoke, I jumped into the bushes alongside the path.
A wide, precipitous mountain range surrounded Gosha Village.
It wasn't very high, but it was steep, and if strangers made their way into it, they would get lost in no time.
(And it's night. Even if Saya has a transmitter attached to her, that woman still won't be able to follow us so easily.)
I knew this mountain like the back of my hand. But it still was not an easy path.
I cut through bushes, over cliffs, and followed along the unmarked path, one step at a time. Gosha Village should have been just around the corner.
Just as I thought that something had come flying at me, a sharp pain shot through my ankle, and I rolled down the slope.
You got ahead of me!? That can't be...
Even if Saya had a transmitter in her, with just a location it should have been impossible to catch up with us in this mountainous area in such a short time.
And getting ahead of me, unless she knew the terrain really well, that shouldn't beー
(No, there is one possibility. The possibility that this woman knows these mountainsーthat she knows Gosha.)
I've cut your ankle. You can't run along this path anymore. Just give up.
L-Let me just ask one thing! You've lived in Gosha, haven't you?!
Murasaki-sensei told me. She told me that you're a Taimanin!
You really are a nosy little boy, aren't you? People don't like that. Or are you just trying to buy some time?
No need to worry, as long as you hand over that artificial demon, I will forgive your little mischief.
Let's see, I'll even say that you've completed my request. Isn't that generous of me?
Behind me, I could hear the sound of many footsteps coming closer. Those must have been mercenaries hired by her.
(Tsk... Can't even escape the way I came from.)
It had happened in the blink of an eye. From behind me, Saya had extended one of her sharp tentacles and pierced the Masked Madam.
Ugh...!? Saya... She still had that much strength...!?
Her stomach pierced, the Masked Madam collapsed on the spot.
But seemingly having used all her energy, Saya fell unconscious again.
(For now I have to get away from here! I can't let the opportunity Saya created go to waste!)
I roused my aching body and continued down the mountain path again.
The Masked Madam was standing there without a single scratch on her.
There was only a fallen oak tree in the spot where she had collapsed. That was the power of her Ninja Art "Decoy Jutsu."
Together with the mercenaries who had caught up to her, the Masked Madam once again continued straight down the path, undeterred.
